description: Switch to a different project on the SAME connection — reuses the current URL + token, so you do NOT re-enter them. Pass the project id; if the user names a project, resolve the name to an id first (SimplifyQA: sqa_query collection "projects" with member:true; Walnut: list_projects). Validated before it is adopted, so a bad id leaves the current project in place.

projectId.description: The project id to switch to. Find it by name with sqa_query collection "projects" (SimplifyQA) or list_projects (Walnut).

name: qa_switch_project
title: Switch the connected project
